elements.description:
Flow diagram of income concepts in the CEQ framework, read top to bottom with downward arrows linking the stacked boxes:

Central stacked boxes (in order):
1. Market Income
2. Market Income Plus Pensions (Pre-fiscal income)
3. Net Market Income
4. Disposable Income
5. Consumer Income
6. Final Income

Side inputs:
- Plus (+) into Market Income Plus Pensions step: Contributory social insurance old-age pensions (net of contributions)
- Minus (−) from Market Income Plus Pensions to Net Market Income step: Direct taxes: PIT, property tax, border tax
- Plus (+) into Net Market Income to Disposable Income step: Direct cash transfers: NAF; bread compensation scheme, Zakat, non-contributory pensions, others.
- Plus (+) into Disposable Income to Consumer Income step: Indirect subsidies (direct and indirect impacts): electricity; water
- Minus (−) from Disposable Income to Consumer Income step: Indirect taxes: GST; SST tobacco, alcohol, sodas, mobile phones
- Plus (+) into Final Income step: In-kind transfers net of user fees: health; education

Source: Adapted from Lustig (2018).
